prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Quick key shortcuts to easily summon, move, and hide your pet anytime on your screen.", "Press Alt+P to show or hide your desktop pet", "Right-click pet anytime for interaction menu & settings", "Got It!"]
1: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Companion?", "Choose a pre-made pet companion or craft a custom friend from your own photos.", "Pick Ready Friend", "Upload Custom Photo"]
2: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Provide 1-3 well-lit photos facing forward so we can render your pet accurately.", "Photos uploaded will be checked for clear faces and lighting."]
3: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Log in with your existing account to restore saved pets or create a new account.", "Existing user? Sign in with original method to recover pets.", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Email"]
4: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "We are compiling 3D models and desktop animations for your companion.", "Estimated wait time: ~2 minutes", "Preparing desktop shaders..."]
5: ["Can't see your pet on screen? Check your taskbar overflow tray or press Alt+P.", "Tip: If your pet isn't visible on desktop, click its tray icon to bring it to the front."]
6: ["Your Pet Brought a Welcome Gift!", "Finish setup now to unlock a free starter toy accessory for your desktop companion.", "🎁 Starter Accessory Unlocked!", "Claim Gift & Launch Pet"]
7: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion in 2 Minutes", "Bring a charming virtual pet directly onto your desktop to keep you company while working or gaming.", "Start Quick Setup"]
8: ["Choose a memorable name! You can edit your pet's name anytime in settings.", "Enter pet name"]
9: []

verdicts.problem: Mentions gifts and free extras to incentivize completing setup
